title: Initial target definition for a 300,000 RMB parcel sorting cell
summary: Defines the first product node, core modules, key metrics, and intended closed-loop demo for low-cost parcel sorting.
limitations: Internal planning evidence only; not a field benchmark or vendor-verified cost.

title: Vendor claims for modular parcel sorting cells and conveyor diverters
sourceName: Representative vendor materials to be reviewed
summary: Placeholder evidence for commercially available sorting cell components and diverter-style routes.
limitations: Unreviewed vendor-style claim; needs replacement with specific product pages, quotes, and field cases.

title: Placeholder field case for parcel variability, jam rate, and operator intervention
summary: Tracks the need for field evidence about parcel mix, exception rates, and operational reliability.
limitations: Placeholder only; should be replaced by real deployment data.

title: Robotic Parcel Inductor
summary: ABB describes an AI-powered parcel inductor module for CEP operations and claims peak performance around 1,500 picks per hour with picking accuracy above 99.5%.
limitations: Vendor product page. Peak pick-rate and picking-accuracy claims are not the same as sustained parcel-sorting throughput, total sort accuracy, jam rate, or field acceptance for the 300,000 RMB v0 cell.

title: Automated Robotic Parcel Infeed System
summary: Wayzim describes a smart-camera and high-speed six-axis robotic parcel infeed system, with claimed infeed efficiency of at least 1,500 pph, double-parcel grasp rate at or below 0.1%, and grasp success rate at or above 99%.
limitations: Vendor page and infeed-only benchmark. Grasp success and double-parcel rate are proxies for exception risk, not reviewed site-level jam or intervention rates.

title: XInduct High-Speed Robotic Induction System
summary: MESH describes a robotic parcel induction system with up to 1,800 picks per hour per robot and 99%+ barcode read rates, with unread parcels routed to an exception area.
limitations: Vendor product page. Barcode read rate and exception diversion are only partial proxies for end-to-end sort accuracy and manual intervention.

title: TITAN robotic parcel singulation
summary: robominds describes the TITAN parcel singulation robot as handling up to 1,800 pph, parcels up to 35 kg and 70 x 70 x 120 cm, with 98% singulation accuracy and integration under one week.
limitations: Vendor page for parcel singulation, not necessarily a complete low-cost sorting cell. Weight/size and installation figures are treated as adjacent benchmarks.

title: AmbiSort A-Series V3 technical specifications
summary: Ambi Robotics' A-Series spec sheet reports more than 325 parcels/hour for bin-fed operation, more than 400 parcels/hour for conveyor-fed operation, greater than 99% correct-output accuracy, more than 96% in-size parcel sortability, and more than 99% uptime.
limitations: Vendor spec sheet. Lower-throughput robot sort cell and weight limits differ from the v0 300,000 RMB suction-arm product target; uptime is a proxy, not a direct jam-rate measurement.

title: High-Speed Parcel Sortation Systems
summary: FloStor's parcel sortation guide frames manual throughput ceilings, automated sort accuracy near 99.9%, high-speed sorters in the tens of thousands of packages per hour, and typical parcel sortation automation ROI around 24-48 months.
limitations: Integrator guide for broader parcel sortation systems. ROI and throughput figures often assume larger, more expensive conveyor sorters rather than one 300,000 RMB robotic cell.

title: Placeholder cost model for low-cost hardware stack
summary: Records that the 300,000 RMB target requires explicit BOM, integration, installation, and maintenance assumptions.
limitations: No priced BOM yet.

title: Annual Robot Maintenance Costs: What to Budget Beyond the Purchase Price
summary: Summarizes annual robot maintenance budget ranges by robot type, including industrial 6-axis robots at roughly 7-12% of purchase price, and describes preventive maintenance, quarterly lubrication/calibration tasks, and annual safety/calibration work.
limitations: Secondary benchmark source, not parcel-cell field data. It covers robot maintenance more than conveyor, vision, suction cup wear, WCS support, and site labor.

title: Robot maintenance cost: full breakdown and savings
summary: Gives a broad industrial robot maintenance-cost reference of about 5-15% of robot purchase price per year, with standard 6-axis units around EUR 2,000-15,000 per year and higher costs under harsher environments or older assets.
limitations: Secondary service-provider guide. It is robot-centric and does not directly price a 300,000 RMB parcel sorting cell in China.

title: Maintenance

limitations: Service-provider checklist for FANUC robots. It supports maintenance scope and cadence, not v0 parcel-cell maintenance cost.
